## GET /admin-api/est

`getEst`

**The EST server: endpoints, Issuing CA, profiles, host names, enrolled certificates, settings**

Everything /admin/est draws. The six RFC 7030 operations at this realm's base URL; the EST Issuing CA and whether the hierarchy is built; the nine profiles with what each needs, whether `est.allowedProfiles` allows it and its labelled URLs; the five profiles never issued over an enrollment protocol and why; the credentials EST accepts; the certificate host names registered in the realm; the certificates enrolled over EST (paged, `certificatesPage`), with no private key; the mode note; and the `est.*` settings, which are written through POST /admin-api/config/set-many.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/cert-issuance` on the admin console.

The reply also carries `protocolEndpoints`: every endpoint of this family in the realm the call arrived in, as `{ name, methods, url }` (plus `route` for an HTTP endpoint, `transport` for a socket, and `registered: false` for a route the router no longer has).

Scope: `admin:read`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `certificatesPage` | query | integer |  | Which page of enrolled certificates. |
| `per` | query | integer |  | Rows per page. |
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

## POST /admin-api/est/add-host-name

`addEstHostName`

**Register a certificate host name on an entry**

A dNSName or iPAddress is issued in a certificate — over ACME, EST or SCEP — only when it is registered on the entry the certificate names. Adding one already there changes nothing.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/est` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hostName` | string | yes | A DNS name or an IP address. |
| `identifier` | string | yes | The username or application identifier. |
| `kind` | one of `person`, `application` | yes | Whether `identifier` names a person (a username) or an application (its identifier). |

**200**: The entry's host names afterwards.

## POST /admin-api/est/issue-server-key

`issueEstServerKey`

**Issue a certificate with a key pair this service generates**

The console's /serverkeygen (RFC 7030 section 4.4): a key pair of `keyAlg` is generated, certified for `profile` by this realm's EST Issuing CA for the person or application named, written onto that entry with a sealed copy of the private key, and returned ONCE as `privateKeyPem`. A KEM key (ML-KEM) is certified only for key-encipherment.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/est` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identifier` | string | yes | The username or application identifier. |
| `keyAlg` | one of `rsa-2048`, `rsa-3072`, `rsa-4096`, `ec-p256`, `ec-p384`, `ec-p521`, `ed25519`, `ml-dsa-44`, `ml-dsa-65`, `ml-dsa-87`, `slh-dsa-sha2-128s`, `slh-dsa-sha2-128f`, `slh-dsa-sha2-192s`, `slh-dsa-sha2-192f`, `slh-dsa-sha2-256s`, `slh-dsa-sha2-256f`, `slh-dsa-shake-128s`, `slh-dsa-shake-128f`, `slh-dsa-shake-192s`, `slh-dsa-shake-192f`, `slh-dsa-shake-256s`, `slh-dsa-shake-256f`, `mldsa44-rsa2048-pss-sha256`, `mldsa44-rsa2048-pkcs15-sha256`, `mldsa44-ed25519-sha512`, `mldsa44-ecdsa-p256-sha256`, `mldsa65-rsa3072-pss-sha512`, `mldsa65-rsa3072-pkcs15-sha512`, `mldsa65-rsa4096-pss-sha512`, `mldsa65-rsa4096-pkcs15-sha512`, `mldsa65-ecdsa-p256-sha512`, `mldsa65-ecdsa-p384-sha512`, `mldsa65-ed25519-sha512`, `mldsa87-ecdsa-p384-sha512`, `mldsa87-ed448-shake256`, `mldsa87-rsa3072-pss-sha512`, `mldsa87-rsa4096-pss-sha512`, `mldsa87-ecdsa-p521-sha512`, `ml-kem-512`, `ml-kem-768`, `ml-kem-1024` |  | A key algorithm id from GET /admin-api/est `keyAlgorithms`; ec-p256 when omitted. |
| `kind` | one of `person`, `application` | yes | Whether `identifier` names a person (a username) or an application (its identifier). |
| `profile` | string |  | One of the nine profiles; `est.defaultProfile` when omitted. |

**200**: The certificate, its chain and the private key, once.

## GET /admin-api/est/monitor

`getEstMonitor`

**What the EST server has done: requests, issuances, refusals**

Everything /admin/est/monitor draws: totals of requests, issued, refused and revoked; the certificates held by status; counts by operation, profile, principal, error code and HTTP status; and the most recent requests (paged, `page`). Per trust realm, across every process, with no reset: the durable record is GET /admin-api/audit.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/est/monitor` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:read`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | query | integer |  | Which page of recent requests. |
| `per` | query | integer |  | Rows per page. |
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

## POST /admin-api/est/remove-host-name

`removeEstHostName`

**Remove a certificate host name from an entry**

Certificates already issued for the name keep it; the next request naming it is refused.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/est` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hostName` | string | yes | The name to remove. |
| `identifier` | string | yes | The username or application identifier. |
| `kind` | one of `person`, `application` | yes | Whether `identifier` names a person (a username) or an application (its identifier). |

## POST /admin-api/est/revoke-certificate

`revokeEstCertificate`

**Revoke a certificate enrolled over EST**

Puts the serial on the EST Issuing CA's CRL with the RFC 5280 reason given (OCSP answers revoked from then on) and marks the record on the entry.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/est` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reason` | one of `unspecified`, `keyCompromise`, `cACompromise`, `affiliationChanged`, `superseded`, `cessationOfOperation`, `certificateHold`, `privilegeWithdrawn`, `aACompromise` |  | The RFC 5280 section 5.3.1 reason; unspecified when omitted. |
| `serial` | string | yes | The serial, from GET /admin-api/est. |

**200**: The serial, the entry and the reason.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entry` | object |  |  |
